task.title: Test Task: Verify End-to-End Routing Pipeline

context.description: Test task to verify the complete routing pipeline works correctly: task-queue → coordinator → handoff → master assignment. This validates that the newly created coordinator-daemon.sh and integration-validator-daemon.sh are functioning properly.
test_objectives: Coordinator reads task from queue within 15 seconds
MoE router assigns task to appropriate master
Handoff file created in master directory
